unclassified.source_text: In addition, all entering freshmen are expected to complete a General Education Seminar during their first year at USC.
unclassified.why: Phrased as an expectation rather than a binding requirement, appears advisory in nature.

unclassified.source_text: Note that courses within the major will also satisfy certain Core Literacy requirements. Please work with your major adviser to determine those courses.
unclassified.why: Advisory guidance directing students to consult an adviser, not itself a constraint.
A total degree unit count that does not specify a filter/pool and does not fit any taxonomy family as a discrete rule; it's the sum of other constraints already captured.

unclassified.source_text: * With correct planning, only 32 units (6 GE and 2 Writing courses) will be needed outside of your major requirements.
unclassified.why: Informational planning note, not a binding requirement.

unclassified.source_text: In cases in which a performance venue is required in order to present the recitals, reservations must be made according to the current guidelines of the Music Operations office.
unclassified.why: Procedural/administrative note about venue reservations, not a degree-plan constraint.
